entities.name: Parhelion
entities.description: Floating golden castle, great hall of the Boros angels, destroyed after Szadek took it.

entities.name: Parhelion II
entities.description: Rebuilt Boros flying fortress home to battle angels and griffin skyknights.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The guild whose angels reside in the Parhelion.

entities.name: Sunhome
entities.description: Fortress with which the Parhelion docked.

entities.name: Feather
entities.description: Angel restricted from the Parhelion and forced to serve the Wojek.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Enslaved by Augustin IV, he killed the Parhelion's residents and planned to destroy Prahv and the Guilds.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Enemy army in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Battle in which Parhelion II served as a base.

events.summary: Angels build the Parhelion as a skyship to seek the vanished planeswalkers and fly it to the edge of Ravnica's existence.
Feather is restricted from the Parhelion and forced to serve the Wojek with bound wings.
events.quote: her wings were bound and she was forced to serve the Wojek

events.summary: Szadek gains access to the Parhelion, kills its residents and plans to destroy Prahv and the Guilds.
events.quote: managed to gain access to the Parhelion and managed to kill its residents

events.summary: Agrus Kos stops the plan but the Parhelion is destroyed.
events.quote: Although his plan was stopped by Agrus Kos , the Parhelion was destroyed.

events.summary: Parhelion II is steered to the Tenth District plaza in the War of the Spark and used to launch skyknights and angels against the Dreadhorde.
events.quote: used as a base for launching skyknights and angels against the Dreadhorde

relations.quote: his plan was stopped by Agrus Kos

relations.note: Used as a flying fortress by the Boros.
relations.quote: is used by the Boros as a flying fortress
